# Urban Beauty

> Beauty supply store based in Austin, Texas. A clean, packed beauty supply in North Austin: walls of braiding hair, wigs, hair care, makeup, bonnets and wraps at fair prices, with a team that helps you find exactly what you came for.

- Phone: (512) 838-6787
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Pflugerville, Wells Branch, Round Rock, Manor, Hutto
- Google rating: 4.4 from 456 reviews

## Services
- Braiding hair: Aisles of pre-stretched braiding hair and crochet hair in every color, stocked deep enough for a full head.
- Wigs: A long wall of wigs on mannequin heads, with a counter and mirror so you can see it before you buy.
- Hair care: Long aisles of shampoos, conditioners, edge control, oils and styling products for natural and relaxed hair.
- Makeup, lashes & nails: Full makeup aisles: lip, brow, lashes, concealer and foundation in deep shades, plus handmade press-on nails.
- Bonnets, wraps & edge scarves: Satin bonnets, edge-laying scarves and printed headwraps in every color you can think of.
- Fragrance, jewelry & tools: Etlee eau de parfum, body mists and oils, nose rings and studs, sunglasses, and the tools braiders need.

## About
Urban Beauty sits in the strip center at 405 E Braker Ln in North Austin, under big white URBAN BEAUTY letters on a navy metal front. Inside it is bright, clean and packed: aisles of braiding hair, a long wig wall, hair care, makeup and lashes, racks of bonnets and headwraps, fragrance and jewelry. We are open every day of the week, and we always try to have your favorite brands in stock. What customers talk about most is the selection, the clean store, fair prices and a team that takes the time to help. One shopper tried three beauty supply stores in Austin and called this one the best by far. Another walked in, got exactly what she needed plus tips on other products, and left a regular.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Saturday 9 AM to 7 PM and Sunday 12 PM to 5 PM. Holiday hours can differ, so call (512) 838-6787 to check.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 405 E Braker Ln, Austin, TX 78753, in the strip center with its own parking lot. Look for the big white URBAN BEAUTY letters on the navy front.
- Q: Do you carry braiding hair?
  A: Yes, a whole wall of it, including X-Pression pre-stretched braiding hair in lots of colors. Need a lot of one color for a full head? Call (512) 838-6787 and we will check the shelf.
- Q: Can I try on a wig?
  A: Yes. Pick up a wig cap at the register (54 cents); personal wig caps are not allowed, for hygiene. You can try up to 4 wigs per visit. All wig purchases are final sale, so take your time and ask us about color, length and style.
- Q: Do you carry makeup for darker skin tones?
  A: Yes. Our makeup aisles carry foundation, concealer, lip and brow lines with a wide range of deep shades, plus lashes and press-on nails.
- Q: Can I call to check if something is in stock?
  A: Yes, call (512) 838-6787 and we will check for you before you drive over.
